purpose: Lets people attach several files and follow each one: a dropzone (or a single Upload files button) above a list of file rows. Use it where uploads are part of the task and their progress matters.

notFor.case: A single drop area where no list of files needs to be followed.
Showing the progress of a task that is not a file upload.
Only an image preview is needed, with no upload.

Default.visual: Its children draw every state: the FileUploadDropzone (or trigger Button) and each FileUploadItem by its Status.

a11y.role: none on the container; a polite live region (aria-live) announces completed, removed and failed files; each uploading row is a progressbar
a11y.keyboard: The dropzone's Button or the trigger Button opens the native picker (Tab, then Enter / Space); each row's actions are their own tab stops.
notes: When a row is removed, focus moves to a neighbouring row.

openQuestions: Who moves focus to a neighbouring row after Remove, and who writes the live-region text: the component or the app (the announcement prop)?
FileUpload has no Disabled or Invalid of its own; should those cascade to the dropzone and the rows like Size does?
